messages:
Nora (partnerships): Quick sync: SummitX co-hosted session next Thu. Need to lock speakers, demo contingency, and swag manifest by EOD. Who can join a quick 15m?
Ibrahim (events): I can at 2pm PT. I'll cover rehearsal windows and AV handoffs.
Chen (hw-ops): Shipping status: demo crate leaving Wed morning. Carrier says 48h transit. Packing list updated in drive.
Riya (devrel): I'll prepare a fallback: recorded demo + public sandbox link. Will post registry tag in chat.
Omar (marketing): Swag: 120 tees, 150 stickers, 80 postcards, plus 200 QR cards with promo code. fulfillment-bot, confirm pickup slot?
fulfillment-bot: Pickup confirmed Fri 9:30am. Manifest ID SX-2026-45. ETA to venue Mon 7pm.
Nora (partnerships): Two asks: 1) single-line fallback for MC, 2) final slide deck in shared drive.
Ibrahim (events): MC fallback: "If live demo is unavailable we'll play a short recorded walkthrough and continue with Q&A." Adding to runbook.
Chen (hw-ops): Network note: venue requires firewall whitelist. If blocked, fallback is LTE hotspot + local container.
Riya (devrel): Registry: registry.redwood/summitx-demo:live-fallback. Launch script added to runbook.
Omar (marketing): I'll draft follow-up email and the co-authored blog outline. Need speaker bios by tomorrow noon.
Nora (partnerships): Great. 2pm PT sync invite sent. Please bring any blockers. Thanks! :handshake:
